userStories.name: Repair web scenario-run contract drift
userStories.description: Align the web scenario-run helper tests and stream fallback with the mounted scenario-run contract: POST /api/vertex/v1/scenarios/{scenarioRid}/runs accepts a run as 202 {runRid,status}; terminal state comes from GET /runs/{runRid}; the stream fallback parses VertexScenarioRun.rid/status without misreporting pending, running, or canceled states.
bdd_acceptance: Given the mounted run start route returns 202 {runRid,status}, When the web scenario-run helper parses the response, Then it preserves the accepted run RID and status instead of expecting durationMs or a terminal scenario payload.

Given a started run, When the web helper needs terminal state, Then it builds the mounted GET /api/vertex/v1/scenarios/{scenarioRid}/runs/{runRid} route and leaves terminal parsing to the run-record polling helper.
Given the stream fallback polls a mounted VertexScenarioRun record with {rid,status:'succeeded'}, When the record is terminal success, Then it emits a completed event using rid as scenarioRunRid.
Given the stream fallback polls a mounted VertexScenarioRun record with {rid,status:'failed',error}, When the record is terminal failure, Then it emits a failed event using rid and the server error.

Given the stream fallback polls a mounted VertexScenarioRun record with pending, running, or canceled status, When the status is not succeeded or failed, Then it returns null rather than inventing a failed event.
quality_gates: `npm test -- scenarioRun.test.ts scenarioRunAsync.test.ts scenarioRunStream.test.ts` from web/
